description: Authoritative Granblue Fantasy Combat Tactical Action Priority Matrix, defining autonomous skill classification, lockout-optimized execution ordering, and combat safety interlocks.

executionTiers.name: V2 Omen Interception & Triage
executionTiers.description: Evaluate active V2 omen cancel conditions (hit count, skill damage, charge attack count, plain damage, dispels). If cancel condition is solvable, prioritize designated solver skills/summons before general rotation.

executionTiers.name: Status Effect Safety Interlocks & Cleanse/Dispel
executionTiers.description: If party is afflicted by Zombified, lock out all healing. If boss has Repel, 100% Cut, or Absorption, immediately fire Dispel before any damage.

executionTiers.name: Field & Domain Abilities (Zone Setup)
executionTiers.description: Cast field effects first (e.g. Field of Death, Flare, Blizzard) as they persist across multiple turns and amplify all subsequent damage without being consumed.

executionTiers.name: Enemy Debuff Application & Defense Lowering
executionTiers.description: Apply Single DEF Down (25%) + Dual DEF Down (Miserable Mist 25%) to reach the hard 50% DEF Down cap before casting offensive steroids or nukes.

executionTiers.name: Team Steroids, Multi-Attack & Damage Amplification
executionTiers.description: Apply team buffs (ATK Up, Guaranteed TA, Supplemental Damage, Echoes, Strike/Assassin buffs) to ensure all following attacks/ougis hit maximum damage cap.

executionTiers.name: Multi-Hit & High-Multiplier Skill Nukes
executionTiers.description: Cast damaging skills. Benefits from full 50% DEF down, team steroids, and supplemental damage buffs established in Tiers 3 & 4.

executionTiers.name: Quick Summon & Summon Calls
executionTiers.description: Invoke Quick Summon (Beelzebub, The Sun, Triple Zero, Death) to inflict debuffs, force party double strike, or guarantee triple attacks.

executionTiers.name: Attack Dispatch & Lockout-Optimized Animation Skip
executionTiers.description: Click .btn-attack-start. In high-speed farming, execute F5 reload to bypass CreateJS battle animations, taking advantage of deterministic server lockout.
